# Claudia Partner Docs

Public documentation for API 0.7.0-experimental. All API services are in MCP scope; only the 8-tool import adapter is currently implemented. Environment enablement and authorization remain required.

- [画像・Dropbox連携](https://mxd2024.github.io/claudia-partner-docs/v0.7/guide/media.md)
- [AIエージェント・MCP](https://mxd2024.github.io/claudia-partner-docs/v0.7/guide/mcp.md)
